slug.description: Stable filename slug. Optional: the loader derives it from the artifact's filename under `.workspec/<kind-dir>/<slug>.yaml` when absent; when present it must already be a valid slug.

spec.description: A system-requirement: ONE Gherkin scenario. The file is the scenario, the slug is the scenario name is the identity. No nested scenarios[], no scenario id.

examples.description: Optional examples table → Scenario Outline. given/when/then may reference "<placeholder>" tokens keyed on these columns; no placeholder cross-validation in T1.

feature.description: Bare-slug intra-tree ref → features/*: the containing feature.

given.description: Gherkin "Given" steps (preconditions). Continuation steps are additional array items.

then.description: Gherkin "Then" steps (the assertions). At least one — a scenario without an assertion is meaningless.

title.description: One-line summary of what the scenario asserts.

userReqs.description: Bare-slug intra-tree refs → requirements/user/*: the user-requirement(s) this scenario verifies (the "verifies" edge; at least one).

items.description: A WorkSpec slug: lowercase alphanumeric segments separated by single hyphens, at most 64 characters (the shape `slugify()` produces).

when.description: Gherkin "When" steps (the action). Continuation steps are additional array items.
